name: Winsome Textile Industries Limited
about: Winsome Textile Industries Limited engages in manufactures and sells yarns and fabrics for knitting and weaving in India. The company offers raw white, dyed, fancy, mélange, neps, jaspe/siro, sparkle, shiny, chill and flake, vintage, injection slub, wool touch, linen look, fluorescent, and new yarn; knitted fashion; and shade cards. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Chandigarh, India.
